| H13b probe cost small | R4-R2 = +4.4 pp | 95% [+0.8, +7.8] | upper < +5 | **NOT supported** | 0.38975 (H0: diff>=5) | 0.38975 |

Holm: step-down on the three one-sided bootstrap p-values (family of 3). Per hypothesis card v8.1: family-wise alpha = 0.05 on the Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p-values.

* H13: unadjusted supported; Holm-adjusted p = 0.00015 -> survives Holm (alpha 0.05): yes.
* H13b: unadjusted not supported; Holm-adjusted p = 0.38975 -> survives Holm (alpha 0.05): no.
* H14: unadjusted supported; Holm-adjusted p = 0.09400 -> survives Holm (alpha 0.05): no.
